title: Personal Loans Returned-Payment Fees: AutoPay Share for Cleared Debits
content:
## Rule

A returned-fee AutoPay share of a Personal Loans returned-payment fee applies, counting the AutoPay debits that cleared on the loan (posted less returned) fewer than 24 whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the returned-payment fee's assessment date: 20 or more give 0.9; 12 to 19 give 0.95; fewer than 12 give no returned-fee share. An AutoPay debit is any payment AutoPay took on the loan, a hardship plan payment included, and an AutoPay debit returned is a return of such a payment.

The share multiplies the returned-payment fee amount while it is still unrounded.

| Cleared AutoPay debits, fewer than 24 whole months back | Share |
|---|---|
| 20 or more | 0.9 |
| 12 to 19 | 0.95 |
| fewer than 12 | no share |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- 21 AutoPay debits posted in the time and 1 of them returned (the bounce being charged): 20 cleared: 0.9.
- 13 posted, 2 returned: 11 cleared: no share.
